title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-oke1: 6 test call sites use stale 2-arg Fragment::from_bytes
description:
Commit e68d331ac9 correctly updates fuzz_fragment.rs to call Fragment::from_bytes(data) with a single argument (matching the actual API at fragment.rs:160). However, 6 other call sites in test files still use the old 2-argument signature Fragment::from_bytes(&wire, &mut tile), which will cause compilation failures:

- tests/fragmentation.rs:123 — malformed_codec_inputs_are_rejected
- tests/fragmentation.rs:125 — malformed_codec_inputs_are_rejected
- tests/fragmentation.rs:236 — multi_fragment_single_window
- tests/fragmentation_vectors.rs:214 — vector test
- tests/fragmentation_vectors.rs:241 — retransmission test
- tests/fragmentation_vectors.rs:379 — invalid fragment test

The `tile` local variables may also become unused once the calls are fixed (if they are only consumed by from_bytes). Each call site needs:
1. Remove `&mut tile` arg from `Fragment::from_bytes(...)` call
2. Remove `let mut tile = [0u8; TILE_SIZE]` declaration if `tile` is unused elsewhere in scope
3. Remove unused `TILE_SIZE` import if no longer referenced in the file
